title: Synthesis of some new pyrene-based hydrazinyl-thiazole derivatives via a one-pot strategy: biological evaluation and molecular docking studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6612-6624
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09880G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pramod Dinkar Jawalepatil, Amol Maruti Jadhav, Pritam Bhagwan Bhosale, Pooja Singh, Hyun Ho Choi, Sang Yong Nam, Mahesh Narayan Waman, Gajanan Namdeo Wadje, Satish Uttamrao Deshmukh
In this study, we report a streamlined one-pot synthesis of a new series of (E)-4-phenyl-2-(2-(pyren-1-ylmethylene)hydrazinyl)thiazole derivatives (4a–4o).
